summary: A depot without a machine that pays the visitor can still be regulated under rules written for one.
realLife: In 2023 testimony on Maine LD 1909, outgoing CLYNK CEO Alison Vanderhoof said CLYNK's account-based service operated under the reverse vending category because the earlier statute did not describe its business model.
gates: An operator asks which existing category covers a bag left for later counting.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: an operator asks which existing category covers a bag left for later counting.

turns.what: The regulator explains the basis of the existing classification.
turns.pulledBy: The permit still uses the machine category.
turns.writesBack: The operator takes that mismatch to the work session.

turns.what: The operator applies under the new description.
turns.pulledBy: A distinct bulk-processing category has taken effect.
turns.writesBack: The license file changes at renewal.
